title: Integral closure commutes with smooth ring base change
statement: Let $R,T,B$ be commutative rings equipped with homomorphisms $R\to T$ and $R\to B$. Assume that $R\to T$ is smooth [def-weil-pbc-smooth-ring-map]. Let $C\subseteq B$ be the integral closure of $R$ in $B$ [def-weil-pbc-integral-closure]. Give $T\otimes_R B$ and $T\otimes_R C$ their tensor-product algebra structures, with $(t\otimes b)(t^{\prime}\otimes b^{\prime})=tt^{\prime}\otimes bb^{\prime}$ [def-weil-pbc-module-tensor-product]. Then the canonical $T$-algebra map $T\otimes_R C\longrightarrow\operatorname{IC}_T(T\otimes_R B)$, $t\otimes c\longmapsto t\otimes c$, is an isomorphism, where the target is the integral closure of $T$ in $T\otimes_R B$. No injectivity, nonzero-ring, reducedness, Noetherian or finiteness assumption on $B$ is imposed.
